# Log: a fallen trunk 3.2 m long, 0.56 thick (the scene sinks it 0.12 m into the water); pale cut
# ends; the faces looking down are deleted. Origin on its axis. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.6196 0.4941 0.4549 --no-slot
material new Cut --base-color 0.8667 0.8314 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Log --vertices 8 --radius 0.28 --depth 3.2 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Bark
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.x) > 0.9"
material assign Cut
select face where "normal.z < -0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export log.glb
